name: Nanami Kai
source:
Nanami is the school nurse and counselor at Sora's school. He is extremely friendly and caring, and is well liked by the student body. He is a housewife-type that enjoys cooking and cleaning, and is viewed by Sora as a mother-figure.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/sukisho/sukisho1.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
